s.g: (rare) Any marine annelid of the genus Hyalinoecia, especially Hyalinoecia tubicola of Europe, which inhabits a transparent movable tube resembling a quill in color and texture.

sao.f: (uncountable) Initialism of session-at-once, a recording mode for optical discs.

s.g: A critically endangered ruminant of species Pseudoryx nghetinhensis, of Vietnam and Laos.
